Output/Fix: Check participant not already in vector before adding

Output/Fix: Add blacklist validation if required by use case

Label: SecurityError/UndocumentedDeflationaryMechanism
Output/Fix: Document transfer tax and emit burn events

Output/Fix: Cap individual voting power at X% of total supply

Label: SecurityError/SilentContractUpgrade
Output/Fix: In Sui/Move, upgrades are controlled via UpgradeCap with UpgradePolicy; storing a code_hash field does not perform actual upgrades — use package upgrade authorization and emit an event via the upgrade process

Label: SecurityError/FeeCollectionWithoutRestriction
Output/Fix: Restrict to fee collector role with proper authorization

Label: SecurityError/LiquidationOrderDependency
Output/Fix: Use fair liquidation queue or batching

Label: SecurityError/CompoundingPrecisionLoss
Output/Fix: Use higher precision arithmetic or different formula

Label: SecurityError/UnrestrictedTokenRescue

Label: SecurityError/NoUpdateFrequencyLimit

Label: SecurityError/NoWithdrawalQueue

Label: SecurityError/HarvestFrontrunning

Label: SecurityError/SelfreferralPossible
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SelfreferralPossible: no check prevents a user from passing their own address as referrer and collecting the bonus themselves; add assert!(referrer != tx_context::sender(ctx), ERROR_SELF_REFERRAL) before awarding the bonus.

Label: SecurityError/VestingScheduleManipulation
SecurityError/WithdrawCollateralWithoutHealthCheck
Output/Fix: Verify remaining collateral maintains safe loan-to-value ratio

Label: SecurityError/NoAirdropClaimTracking
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoAirdropClaimTracking: claimed addresses are never recorded; the same wallet can call claim_airdrop repeatedly and drain the airdrop pool; add a Table<address, bool> of claimed addresses, assert the sender has not claimed, then insert sender before minting.

Label: SecurityError/NoUnstakingDelay
Output/Fix: Add mandatory cooldown period before withdrawal

Label: SecurityError/DonationInflationAttack
Output/Fix: Prevent donations or use virtual reserves

Label: SecurityError/HardcodedDecimalAssumption
Output/Fix: Read decimals from token metadata dynamically

Label: SecurityError/UnboundedUserControlledLoop
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnboundedUserControlledLoop: the loop bound `count` is entirely caller-supplied with no upper limit; a malicious caller can pass count = u64::MAX to exhaust the transaction gas budget and grief other users; add assert!(count <= MAX_ENTRIES, ERROR_EXCEEDS_LIMIT) before the loop.

Label: SecurityError/MissingMultisigThresholdCheck
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MissingMultisigThresholdCheck: execute_multisig_action never verifies that the required number of signers approved the proposal; add assert!(proposal.approval_count >= wallet.required_signatures, ERROR_THRESHOLD_NOT_MET) before executing the payload.

Label: SecurityError/UnrestrictedRoleEscalation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnrestrictedRoleEscalation: any role-holder can grant any role including admin; verify the caller holds a role that is permitted to grant the specific target role, e.g., assert!(caller_role >= role, ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGE).

Label: SecurityError/MissingPendingOwnerCheck
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MissingPendingOwnerCheck: accept_ownership does not verify the caller equals asset.pending_owner; any address can call this and steal ownership; add assert!(tx_context::sender(ctx) == asset.pending_owner, ERROR_NOT_PENDING_OWNER).

Label: SecurityError/ExpiredDelegationNotChecked
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ExpiredDelegationNotChecked: delegated capability is used without checking its expiry; add assert!(tx_context::epoch(ctx) < cap.expires_at, ERROR_DELEGATION_EXPIRED) before performing the privileged action.

Label: SecurityError/IrrecoverableAdminRenouncement
Output/Fix: SecurityError/IrrecoverableAdminRenouncement: AdminCap is deleted without verifying a successor capability exists; if no replacement has been granted the protocol becomes permanently ungovernable; require a pending_admin address to be set before allowing renouncement.

Label: SecurityError/PublicOperatorChange
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PublicOperatorChange: set_operator on a shared Config object has no access check; anyone can overwrite the operator address; add assert!(tx_context::sender(ctx) == config.admin, ERROR_NOT_ADMIN).

Label: SecurityError/UnauthorizedAccountFreeze
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnauthorizedAccountFreeze: freeze_account has no capability check; any caller can freeze any account, enabling griefing; require a FreezeCap parameter or assert the caller is an authorised compliance officer.

Label: SecurityError/UnauthorizedUnpause
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnauthorizedUnpause: unpause_module carries no capability requirement so any caller can resume a deliberately paused module; require an AdminCap or governance multi-sig to authorise the unpause.

Label: SecurityError/UnrestrictedFeeModification
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnrestrictedFeeModification: set_protocol_fee has no access control; any caller can set the fee to an arbitrary value including 100%; require a FeeAdminCap parameter and validate new_fee <= MAX_FEE before updating.

Label: SecurityError/UnauthorizedLiquidityDrain
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnauthorizedLiquidityDrain: remove_all_liquidity does not verify the caller holds LP tokens proportional to the requested amount; any caller can drain the entire pool; verify caller LP balance and burn LP tokens before transferring reserves.

Label: SecurityError/UnauthorizedConfigUnlock
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnauthorizedConfigUnlock: unlock_config has no capability or ownership check; any caller can unlock a deliberately locked configuration; require an AdminCap and assert the timelock has expired before unlocking.

Label: SecurityError/UnrestrictedRewardRateChange
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnrestrictedRewardRateChange: update_reward_rate has no access check and no bounds validation; an attacker can set reward_rate to u64::MAX to drain the reward pool in one claim; require an AdminCap and assert new_rate <= MAX_REWARD_RATE.

Label: SecurityError/QuorumBreakingSignerRemoval
Output/Fix: SecurityError/QuorumBreakingSignerRemoval: remove_signer does not verify that remaining signers >= required_signatures after removal; this can permanently lock the wallet; add assert!(vector::length(&wallet.signers) - 1 >= wallet.required_signatures, ERROR_QUORUM_BROKEN) before removing.

Label: SecurityError/UnrestrictedMinterAssignment
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnrestrictedMinterAssignment: set_minter has no authority check; any caller can assign themselves as minter and mint unlimited tokens; require a TreasuryAdminCap and assert caller is the current token owner.

Label: SecurityError/ForcedNftTransferWithoutConsent
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ForcedNftTransferWithoutConsent: force_transfer_nft changes the owner field without requiring the current owner's signature or a marketplace capability; require either the current owner to sign or a platform-issued TransferAuthCap.

Label: SecurityError/UnrestrictedCollateralParamChange
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnrestrictedCollateralParamChange: update_min_collateral has no access control; an attacker can set min_collateral_ratio to 0 making all positions under-collateralised; require GovernanceCap and enforce a safe minimum bound.

Label: SecurityError/UnrestrictedTemplateOverride
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnrestrictedTemplateOverride: set_pool_template has no capability check; an attacker can point the factory at a malicious template address so all subsequently created pools are compromised; require FactoryAdminCap.

Label: SecurityError/UnrestrictedFeeRecipientChange
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnrestrictedFeeRecipientChange: set_lp_fee_recipient has no ownership check; any caller can redirect accumulated protocol fees to their own address; require PoolAdminCap and emit a FeeRecipientUpdated event.

Label: SecurityError/UnrestrictedLiquidationBonusChange
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnrestrictedLiquidationBonusChange: set_liquidation_bonus has no access control; an attacker can set bonus_bps to 10000 (100%) so liquidators seize the entire collateral; require MarketAdminCap and assert bonus_bps <= MAX_BONUS_BPS.

Label: SecurityError/UnauthorizedInsuranceDrain
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnauthorizedInsuranceDrain: drain_insurance has no access restriction; any caller can empty the insurance fund; require InsuranceAdminCap, a multi-sig approval, and a mandatory timelock delay before allowing fund withdrawal.

Label: SecurityError/MissingZeroStakeGuard
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MissingZeroStakeGuard: epoch_rewards * precision / total_staked aborts with division-by-zero when total_staked == 0; add assert!(total_staked > 0, ERROR_NO_STAKERS) before the division.

Label: SecurityError/VestedAmountOverflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/VestedAmountOverflow: total * elapsed can overflow u64 when both are large; compute with checked arithmetic: assert!(total <= MAX_U64 / elapsed, ERROR_OVERFLOW) or scale down before multiplying.

Label: SecurityError/AmmNumeratorOverflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/AmmNumeratorOverflow: amount_in * reserve_out overflows u64 when reserves are large; apply fee before the multiplication and assert amount_in <= MAX_U64 / reserve_out, or use u128 for the intermediate product.

Label: SecurityError/InterestAccrualOverflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/InterestAccrualOverflow: debt * rate_bps * elapsed_epochs can overflow u64 for large debts or long durations; compute step-by-step with overflow assertions at each multiplication, or cap elapsed_epochs to a safe maximum.

Label: SecurityError/PrecisionScaleOverflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PrecisionScaleOverflow: amount * price overflows u64 when PRECISION is 1e18 and amount or price is large; use u128 for the intermediate product: (amount as u128 * price as u128 / PRECISION as u128) as u64.

Label: SecurityError/RoyaltySubtractionUnderflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/RoyaltySubtractionUnderflow: if royalty_bps > 10000 the royalty exceeds sale_price and the subtraction aborts; assert royalty_bps <= 10000 and compute the royalty amount before subtracting.

Label: SecurityError/RewardPrecisionTruncation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/RewardPrecisionTruncation: integer division total_rewards / total_supply truncates to zero when total_rewards < total_supply causing all stakers to receive zero rewards; scale by a PRECISION factor before dividing: (total_rewards * PRECISION) / total_supply.

Label: SecurityError/CollateralCalculationOverflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/CollateralCalculationOverflow: debt * collateral_ratio overflows when debt is large and collateral_ratio is expressed in basis points without a divisor; add the divisor debt * collateral_ratio / 10000 and assert debt <= MAX_U64 / collateral_ratio before multiplying.

Label: SecurityError/LpMintOverflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/LpMintOverflow: deposit_a * total_lp overflows u64 when both values are near u64::MAX; use u128 for the intermediate multiplication: ((deposit_a as u128 * total_lp as u128) / reserve_a as u128) as u64.

Label: SecurityError/TickPriceLoopOverflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/TickPriceLoopOverflow: repeated multiplication by 10001/10000 will overflow u64 for large tick values; cap tick to a safe maximum or use logarithmic price representation instead of iterative multiplication.

Label: SecurityError/AccumulatedRewardOverflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/AccumulatedRewardOverflow: each iteration adds stake * rate to total without overflow checking; for large stake vectors the accumulator will overflow u64; assert each addition does not exceed MAX_U64 or use u128 accumulator.

Label: SecurityError/SlashPercentageMissingDivisor
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SlashPercentageMissingDivisor: slash_amount = stake.amount * slash_pct is missing the /100 divisor; if slash_pct = 50 the slash_amount is 50x the stake causing underflow; compute slash_amount = stake.amount * slash_pct / 100 and assert slash_pct <= 100.

Label: SecurityError/UnlockTimeOverflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnlockTimeOverflow: tx_context::epoch(ctx) + duration overflows u64 when duration is near u64::MAX creating an unlock_time of 0 or a very small epoch; assert duration <= MAX_LOCK_DURATION before adding.

Label: SecurityError/FeeNumeratorOverflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/FeeNumeratorOverflow: trade_size * fee_numerator overflows u64 when trade_size is large; validate trade_size <= MAX_U64 / fee_numerator, or use u128 for the intermediate product.

Label: SecurityError/ExponentiationOverflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ExponentiationOverflow: result * base overflows u64 quickly for base > 1; for base = 2 overflow occurs at exp = 64; add assert!(result <= MAX_U64 / base, ERROR_OVERFLOW) inside the loop.

Label: SecurityError/BondPayoutChainOverflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/BondPayoutChainOverflow: chained multiplication principal * (10000 + discount_bps) * vesting_factor can overflow u64 in two places; perform each multiplication separately with overflow assertions or use u128.

Label: SecurityError/SupplyCapOverflowBeforeCheck
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SupplyCapOverflowBeforeCheck: current + amount overflows u64 before the cap check is reached when current + amount > u64::MAX; add assert!(amount <= MAX_U64 - current, ERROR_OVERFLOW) before the addition.

Label: SecurityError/DailyLimitOverflowBypass
Output/Fix: SecurityError/DailyLimitOverflowBypass: existing + new_amount can overflow u64 wrapping to a value <= limit, bypassing the daily limit check; add assert!(new_amount <= MAX_U64 - existing, ERROR_OVERFLOW) before the addition.

Label: SecurityError/MissingPercentageDivisor
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MissingPercentageDivisor: release amount is computed as escrow.amount * release_pct without dividing by 100; for release_pct = 50 the result is 50x the escrow amount; change to escrow.amount * release_pct / 100 and assert release_pct <= 100.

Label: SecurityError/TwapAccumulatorOverflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/TwapAccumulatorOverflow: new_price * elapsed overflows u64 for large prices or long intervals, and the accumulated sum will eventually overflow too; use u128 for cumulative_price and the intermediate product.

Label: SecurityError/UnstakeClaimReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnstakeClaimReentrancy: pool.stakes and pool.rewards are zeroed after transfer_tokens; set both to 0 before transferring to prevent re-entrant calls from reading stale non-zero balances.

Label: SecurityError/GrantReleaseReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/GrantReleaseReentrancy: grant.paid is set after transfer_funds; set paid = true before the transfer to prevent a re-entrant call from releasing the same grant multiple times.

Label: SecurityError/YieldWithdrawReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/YieldWithdrawReentrancy: deposits and pending_yield are updated after transfer_coins; zero out both before transferring to prevent re-entrant withdrawals that read stale non-zero values.

Label: SecurityError/LiquidationReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/LiquidationReentrancy: vault.liquidated is set after send_collateral; set vault.liquidated = true before calling send_collateral to prevent re-entrant liquidation calls that see liquidated == false and seize collateral twice.

Label: SecurityError/FlashLoanFlagNotReset
Output/Fix: SecurityError/FlashLoanFlagNotReset: flash_loan_active is set to true but never reset after the loan is taken; use a hot-potato receipt pattern: return a FlashLoanReceipt that must be consumed by a repay function in the same transaction.

Label: SecurityError/TreasuryProposalReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/TreasuryProposalReentrancy: proposal.executed is set after release_treasury_funds; mark executed = true before releasing funds to prevent re-entrant calls from executing the same proposal and double-spending treasury funds.

Label: SecurityError/AuctionSettlementReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/AuctionSettlementReentrancy: auction.settled is set last; set auction.settled = true at the start of settle_auction so any re-entrant call finds the auction already settled and aborts.

Label: SecurityError/WithdrawalQueueReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/WithdrawalQueueReentrancy: the request is removed from the queue after transfer_to_user; remove the request before transferring so a re-entrant call cannot find and replay the same request.

Label: SecurityError/RepayCollateralReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/RepayCollateralReentrancy: collateral is transferred before the loan debt is updated and collateral_amount zeroed; update loan state first then transfer collateral to prevent re-entrant calls from withdrawing collateral against an uncleared debt.

Label: SecurityError/VoteRefundReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/VoteRefundReentrancy: vote record and deposit are cleared after transfer_refund; zero the deposit and remove the vote entry before issuing the refund to prevent double-refund through re-entrant calls.

Label: SecurityError/FeeCollectionReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/FeeCollectionReentrancy: accumulated_protocol_fees is zeroed after the transfer; zero the accumulator before calling coin::take to prevent a re-entrant collect_protocol_fees from double-collecting the same fees.

Label: SecurityError/BridgeClaimReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/BridgeClaimReentrancy: pending claim is removed after mint_tokens; remove the claim entry before minting to prevent a re-entrant claim_bridged_tokens from minting tokens multiple times for the same nonce.

Label: SecurityError/StreamWithdrawReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/StreamWithdrawReentrancy: last_withdrawn_at and withdrawn_total are updated after send_payment; update both state fields before sending the payment to prevent re-entrant withdraw_stream calls from computing a stale claimable_amount.

Label: SecurityError/InsuranceClaimReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/InsuranceClaimReentrancy: policy.claimed is set after transfer_payout; set policy.claimed = true before transferring the payout so re-entrant calls are rejected by the assert!(!policy.claimed) guard.

Label: SecurityError/CompoundWithdrawReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/CompoundWithdrawReentrancy: vault.balance is zeroed after transfer; capture the withdrawal amount, zero vault.balance first, then transfer to prevent re-entrant calls from reading the non-zero balance and withdrawing twice.

Label: SecurityError/NoBatchMintLimit
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoBatchMintLimit: quantity is caller-supplied with no upper bound; a single transaction could mint the entire collection supply; add assert!(quantity > 0 && quantity <= MAX_BATCH_MINT, ERROR_INVALID_QUANTITY) before the loop.

Label: SecurityError/NoOrderParamValidation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoOrderParamValidation: price and size are accepted without validation; a price of 0 or size of 0 can corrupt market state; add assert!(price > 0 && size > 0 && size <= MAX_ORDER_SIZE, ERROR_INVALID_ORDER).

Label: SecurityError/NoVotingPeriodBounds
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoVotingPeriodBounds: voting_period has no minimum or maximum; a period of 0 makes proposals immediately executable; a period of u64::MAX causes voting_end overflow; assert MIN_VOTING_PERIOD <= voting_period <= MAX_VOTING_PERIOD.

Label: SecurityError/ZeroInitialPriceAllowed
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ZeroInitialPriceAllowed: initial_price is not validated; a pool initialised with price = 0 causes division-by-zero in all subsequent swap calculations; assert initial_price > 0 && initial_price <= MAX_INITIAL_PRICE.

Label: SecurityError/InvalidStreamTimeRange
Output/Fix: SecurityError/InvalidStreamTimeRange: start_time and end_time are not validated; end_time <= start_time creates a stream with zero or negative duration causing division-by-zero in rate calculations; assert start_time < end_time and end_time - start_time >= MIN_STREAM_DURATION.

Label: SecurityError/MaxSupplyCanBeSetBelowCurrent
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MaxSupplyCanBeSetBelowCurrent: new_max is not validated against current supply; setting max_supply below token.current_supply creates an inconsistent state where minting appears to fail for legitimate reasons; assert new_max >= token.current_supply.

Label: SecurityError/MismatchedSignatureMessageLengths
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MismatchedSignatureMessageLengths: vector::length(&signatures) is never compared to vector::length(&messages); if signatures is shorter, indexing it will abort; add assert!(vector::length(&signatures) == vector::length(&messages), ERROR_LENGTH_MISMATCH) before the loop.

Label: SecurityError/InvalidMerkleRootLength
Output/Fix: SecurityError/InvalidMerkleRootLength: merkle root length is not validated; a root that is not 32 bytes will silently corrupt proof verification; assert vector::length(&root) == 32 before assigning.

Label: SecurityError/NoBorrowAmountValidation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoBorrowAmountValidation: borrow_amount of 0 creates a zero-debt loan that still consumes collateral and storage; assert borrow_amount >= MIN_BORROW_AMOUNT and that borrow_amount does not exceed the collateral value at current prices.

Label: SecurityError/NoPriceFeedDecimalsValidation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoPriceFeedDecimalsValidation: decimals is accepted without validation; decimals = 0 causes division-by-zero in normalisation; decimals > 18 causes precision overflow; assert 0 < decimals <= 18.

Label: SecurityError/CliffExceedsVestingDuration
Output/Fix: SecurityError/CliffExceedsVestingDuration: cliff is not validated against vesting_duration; if cliff > vesting_duration tokens become permanently unclaimable; assert cliff < vesting_duration and vesting_duration >= MIN_VESTING_DURATION.

Label: SecurityError/SwapFeeExceedsHundredPercent
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SwapFeeExceedsHundredPercent: fee_bps is not bounded; setting fee_bps = 10001 makes every swap return 0 output, effectively bricking the pool; assert fee_bps <= MAX_SWAP_FEE_BPS (e.g., 1000 for 10%).

Label: SecurityError/NoReferralCodeLengthCheck
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoReferralCodeLengthCheck: code length is not validated; an empty string collides with other empty codes; an extremely long string wastes storage; assert string::length(&code) >= MIN_CODE_LEN && string::length(&code) <= MAX_CODE_LEN.

Label: SecurityError/QuorumThresholdExceedsSupply
Output/Fix: SecurityError/QuorumThresholdExceedsSupply: threshold_bps is unconstrained; setting it to 0 allows proposals to pass with zero participation; setting it above 10000 makes quorum mathematically unachievable; assert 100 <= threshold_bps <= 10000.

Label: SecurityError/ZeroStakeAmountAllowed
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ZeroStakeAmountAllowed: amount = 0 is accepted, creating a stake entry that earns rewards without depositing any tokens; assert amount >= MIN_STAKE_AMOUNT before updating the stakes table.

Label: SecurityError/MinTransferExceedsMax
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MinTransferExceedsMax: min_transfer and max_transfer are set independently without validating their relationship; if min_transfer > max_transfer no transfer can ever succeed; assert min_transfer > 0 && min_transfer < max_transfer.

Label: SecurityError/UnboundedYieldMultiplier
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnboundedYieldMultiplier: boost_multiplier has no upper bound; a very large multiplier causes overflow in reward calculations and allows draining the vault in a single claim; assert boost_multiplier <= MAX_BOOST_MULTIPLIER.

Label: SecurityError/NoStopOrderValidation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoStopOrderValidation: trigger_price = 0 and amount = 0 are accepted without validation; a zero trigger price fires immediately at any price; assert trigger_price > 0 && amount >= MIN_ORDER_AMOUNT.

Label: SecurityError/RoyaltyExceedsHundredPercent
Output/Fix: SecurityError/RoyaltyExceedsHundredPercent: royalty_bps is not bounded; setting royalty_bps > 10000 means sellers receive negative proceeds, causing underflow in payment calculations; assert royalty_bps <= MAX_ROYALTY_BPS (e.g., 1000 for 10%).

Label: SecurityError/ZeroLiquidityProvision
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ZeroLiquidityProvision: amount_a or amount_b can be 0; providing one-sided or zero liquidity skews the pool price and mints LP tokens without proportional value; assert amount_a >= MIN_LIQUIDITY && amount_b >= MIN_LIQUIDITY.

Label: SecurityError/SharedObjectDeletion
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SharedObjectDeletion: shared objects cannot be deleted by unwrapping in Sui Move; calling object::delete on a shared object id will abort at runtime; either freeze the object, transfer it to the zero address, or redesign to use owned objects.

Label: SecurityError/MissingHotPotatoReceipt
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MissingHotPotatoReceipt: funds are lent without issuing a hot-potato Receipt; the caller can keep the coins with no obligation to repay; return a Receipt alongside the coins and require it be consumed by a repay function in the same transaction.

Label: SecurityError/WrappedObjectSilentlyDropped
Output/Fix: SecurityError/WrappedObjectSilentlyDropped: destroy_wrapper discards the inner NFT with `inner: _`; if NFT does not have the `drop` ability this will fail at runtime; explicitly unwrap and transfer or delete the inner NFT before deleting the wrapper id.

Label: SecurityError/EmptyVectorMergeAbort
Output/Fix: SecurityError/EmptyVectorMergeAbort: vector::pop_back aborts on an empty vector; if coins is empty the function aborts before processing; assert !vector::is_empty(&coins) before popping, or handle the empty case by returning coin::zero<SUI>(ctx).

Label: SecurityError/DynamicFieldMoveWithoutOwnerCheck
Output/Fix: SecurityError/DynamicFieldMoveWithoutOwnerCheck: any caller can move a dynamic object field from one UID to another without verifying ownership of either; require the caller to prove ownership of the source object before permitting the field move.

Label: SecurityError/TreasuryCapDuplication
Output/Fix: SecurityError/TreasuryCapDuplication: TreasuryCap does not have the copy ability in the Sui framework; `copy cap` will not compile; do not attempt to duplicate capabilities — transfer the single TreasuryCap to a multi-sig account instead.

Label: SecurityError/SimultaneousMutableBorrow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SimultaneousMutableBorrow: borrowing &mut parent.id via dynamic_field and then modifying parent.counter in the same scope creates simultaneous mutable borrows of parent; the Move borrow checker will reject this; restructure to finish the dynamic field borrow before accessing other parent fields.

Label: SecurityError/MutatingFrozenObject
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MutatingFrozenObject: frozen objects in Sui are immutable; passing a frozen object as &mut will abort at runtime; use a shared object with access control instead of a frozen object if mutation is required.

Label: SecurityError/CapabilityStoredInSharedTable
Output/Fix: SecurityError/CapabilityStoredInSharedTable: PrivilegeCap has the store ability and is placed in a shared object table; any caller with access to the shared object can retrieve and misuse the capability; remove the store ability from PrivilegeCap or use a private owned-object storage pattern.

Label: SecurityError/ExposedMutableUid
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ExposedMutableUid: returning &mut UID allows callers to attach arbitrary dynamic fields to the object, potentially shadowing existing fields or creating storage bloat; avoid exposing &mut UID publicly; use specific typed accessor functions instead.

Label: SecurityError/TransferPolicyBypass
Output/Fix: SecurityError/TransferPolicyBypass: using transfer::public_transfer bypasses any custom TransferPolicy rules (such as royalty enforcement or KYC checks) registered for type T; use the sui::kiosk transfer flow which enforces TransferPolicy rules.

Label: SecurityError/ZeroCoinCreation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ZeroCoinCreation: coin::zero creates Coin objects with zero value and transfers them; these add object storage cost with no economic value and can be used to spam recipient addresses with empty coin objects; avoid creating or transferring zero-value coins.

Label: SecurityError/IrrecoverableWrappedFreeze
Output/Fix: SecurityError/IrrecoverableWrappedFreeze: wrapping an object and immediately freezing the wrapper makes the inner object permanently unrecoverable; it can never be unwrapped, transferred, or deleted; ensure freeze is intentional and the inner object will not need to be extracted.

Label: SecurityError/TableBorrowAbortOnMissingKey
Output/Fix: SecurityError/TableBorrowAbortOnMissingKey: table::borrow_mut aborts if key does not exist; if the caller passes an address not yet in the table the transaction aborts with a confusing error; check table::contains before borrowing or use table::add for first-time entries.

Label: SecurityError/BalanceSplitWithoutValueCheck
Output/Fix: SecurityError/BalanceSplitWithoutValueCheck: balance::split aborts if amount > balance::value(bal); callers receive no descriptive error; add assert!(amount <= balance::value(bal), ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE) before splitting to provide a meaningful abort code.

Label: SecurityError/SpotPriceCollateralValuation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SpotPriceCollateralValuation: collateral is valued using the instantaneous AMM spot price which can be manipulated by a flash loan; use a TWAP or a Pyth/Switchboard oracle price for collateral valuation.

Label: SecurityError/InstantDepositHarvest
Output/Fix: SecurityError/InstantDepositHarvest: depositing and harvesting in the same transaction extracts rewards without having staked for any real duration; snapshot rewards at deposit time and require at least MIN_STAKE_EPOCHS before allowing harvest.

Label: SecurityError/SelfLiquidationForBonus
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SelfLiquidationForBonus: a position owner can liquidate themselves and collect the liquidation bonus; require that the liquidator address is different from the position owner: assert liquidator != position_owner, ERROR_SELF_LIQUIDATION.

Label: SecurityError/OraclePriceAndBorrowSameCall
Output/Fix: SecurityError/OraclePriceAndBorrowSameCall: price is updated and immediately used to compute borrowing capacity in the same transaction; a privileged caller can inflate price to borrow more; separate oracle update and lending actions, or add a delay between price update and usage.

Label: SecurityError/SimpleAverageTwapManipulation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SimpleAverageTwapManipulation: simple average is used instead of time-weighted average; an attacker who controls update frequency can heavily weight recent prices; weight each update by elapsed time: cumulative += price * elapsed_time, twap = cumulative / total_time.

Label: SecurityError/PoolPriceForLiquidationDecision
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PoolPriceForLiquidationDecision: liquidation decisions are based on pool spot price which can be manipulated within a single transaction; use an external time-delayed oracle price for liquidation threshold checks.

Label: SecurityError/MissingSwapDeadline
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MissingSwapDeadline: the swap has no deadline parameter; a transaction can be held in mempool and executed at an unfavourable time; add a deadline: u64 parameter and assert tx_context::epoch(ctx) <= deadline.

Label: SecurityError/NoArbitrageProfitabilityCheck
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoArbitrageProfitabilityCheck: there is no assertion that the final output exceeds the initial input; the transaction can be sandwiched to make it unprofitable for the caller; add assert!(coin::value(&a_out) > amount, ERROR_NOT_PROFITABLE).

Label: SecurityError/InvalidTickRangeForLiquidity
Output/Fix: SecurityError/InvalidTickRangeForLiquidity: tick_lower and tick_upper are not validated; if tick_lower >= tick_upper the position range is invalid and swap calculations will produce incorrect results; assert tick_lower < tick_upper && tick_lower >= MIN_TICK && tick_upper <= MAX_TICK.

Label: SecurityError/YieldTokenRedemptionWithoutAccrualCheck
Output/Fix: SecurityError/YieldTokenRedemptionWithoutAccrualCheck: redeeming a yield token for its face_value ignores how much yield has actually accrued; an early redemption at full face value drains the vault; calculate actual accrued yield based on time elapsed and vault performance before transferring.

Label: SecurityError/NegativeFundingUnderflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NegativeFundingUnderflow: if mark_price < index_price the subtraction mark_price - index_price underflows u64; handle both positive and negative funding by using signed arithmetic or separate paths for mark > index and mark < index.

Label: SecurityError/PortfolioWeightsSumNotValidated
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PortfolioWeightsSumNotValidated: new_weights are applied without verifying they sum to exactly 10000 bps (100%); weights that sum to less cause assets to be stranded; weights that sum to more cause over-allocation; validate the sum equals 10000 before updating.

Label: SecurityError/HealthCheckAfterDebtUpdate
Output/Fix: SecurityError/HealthCheckAfterDebtUpdate: debt is incremented before the health check; this is the correct order (check post-state), but the health function must also use oracle prices that cannot be manipulated in the same transaction; ensure oracle prices are from a TWAP or are time-delayed.

Label: SecurityError/PriceCapCheckedBeforeSwap
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PriceCapCheckedBeforeSwap: price is checked before the swap but the swap itself changes the price; a large trade could push price well above max_price after the check passes; also check the post-swap price or use a min_out slippage parameter instead.

Label: SecurityError/MedianRequiresMinimumSources
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MedianRequiresMinimumSources: median of only 3 oracle sources means a single compromised oracle (1 of 3) controls the median; require at least 5 sources so 2 need to be compromised to manipulate the median.

Label: SecurityError/VrfProofNotVerified
Output/Fix: SecurityError/VrfProofNotVerified: the VRF output is accepted based only on length without verifying the cryptographic proof against the public key; use sui::vrf to properly verify the proof: vrf::ecvrf_verify(&output, &proof, &public_key).

Label: SecurityError/CommitRevealMissingNonce
Output/Fix: SecurityError/CommitRevealMissingNonce: commitment is hash(value) with no salt; an observer can brute-force the committed value offline before the reveal phase; require a random nonce: commitment = hash(value || nonce), store nonce separately, and verify both at reveal time.

Label: SecurityError/EcdsaSignatureReplay
Output/Fix: SecurityError/EcdsaSignatureReplay: the signed message contains no chain ID, contract address, or nonce; the same signed message can be replayed to execute the same action repeatedly; include a unique nonce and chain context in the signed payload and track consumed nonces.

Label: SecurityError/HashIdWithoutDomainSeparator
Output/Fix: SecurityError/HashIdWithoutDomainSeparator: concatenating two addresses without a domain separator or length prefix can cause different inputs to produce the same hash (e.g. (0x1, 0x23) == (0x12, 0x3)); prepend a fixed domain tag and use length-prefixed encoding.

Label: SecurityError/PredictableGameSeed
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PredictableGameSeed: seed is derived from public on-chain data (epoch and player address) which can be computed in advance; a player can calculate all possible outcomes before committing; use the Sui randomness beacon or a VRF with an unpredictable beacon input.

Label: SecurityError/MissingEthereumSignaturePrefix
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MissingEthereumSignaturePrefix: off-chain Ethereum signatures use the prefix '\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n32' before hashing; omitting the prefix means signatures produced by MetaMask or similar wallets will not verify correctly and the check can be bypassed with a raw ECDSA signature.

Label: SecurityError/MerkleLeafNodeHashingVulnerability
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MerkleLeafNodeHashingVulnerability: leaf nodes and internal nodes are hashed the same way; a crafted proof can use an internal node as a leaf to forge inclusion; prefix leaf hashes with 0x00 and internal node hashes with 0x01 before hashing to prevent second-preimage attacks.

Label: SecurityError/ZkProofPublicInputsNotRangechecked
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ZkProofPublicInputsNotRangechecked: public inputs are passed to the verifier without checking they are valid field elements (< BN254 field prime); out-of-range inputs can cause undefined verifier behaviour; validate each input is within the scalar field before verification.

Label: SecurityError/BlsRogueKeyAttack
Output/Fix: SecurityError/BlsRogueKeyAttack: BLS aggregate verification without proof-of-possession is vulnerable to rogue-key attacks where a malicious party chooses a public key that cancels out honest signers; require each participant to prove possession of their private key during registration.

Label: SecurityError/SchnorrSigWithoutNonceTracking
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SchnorrSigWithoutNonceTracking: the verified message contains no nonce; a valid signature can be replayed in future transactions; include a per-use nonce in the message, store used nonces on-chain, and assert the nonce has not been seen before.

Label: SecurityError/CommitmentHashWithoutBinding
Output/Fix: SecurityError/CommitmentHashWithoutBinding: commitment hash(secret) does not bind to the sender address or action; a front-runner who observes the secret in the mempool can open the commitment themselves; include sender address and action parameters in the committed data.

Label: SecurityError/PreviousEpochAsRandomness
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PreviousEpochAsRandomness: using a previous epoch number as randomness is known before the transaction is submitted; participants can compute the winner in advance and time their entry; use the Sui on-chain randomness object (sui::random) for unpredictable outcomes.

Label: SecurityError/HashComparisonTimingOracle
Output/Fix: SecurityError/HashComparisonTimingOracle: direct byte-vector equality may short-circuit on the first differing byte; in off-chain or zk contexts this creates a timing oracle; use a constant-time comparison function; in on-chain Move all comparisons are equivalent but document that this function must not be replicated in off-chain verifiers without constant-time guarantees.

Label: SecurityError/FreshAddressNotRandomness
Output/Fix: SecurityError/FreshAddressNotRandomness: tx_context::fresh_object_address is a deterministic counter derived from the transaction digest; it is predictable given knowledge of the transaction; use the Sui randomness beacon (sui::random::Random) for unpredictable selection.

Label: SecurityError/DeterministicLotteryWinner
Output/Fix: SecurityError/DeterministicLotteryWinner: the winning condition is computed from on-chain values the player can observe before buying; the player can calculate the exact ticket_number that wins and always claim the prize; use a commit-reveal scheme or the Sui randomness object to determine winners.

Label: SecurityError/EarlyVoteFinalization
Output/Fix: SecurityError/EarlyVoteFinalization: the proposal is finalized as soon as a simple majority is reached, before the voting period ends; late opposing votes are ignored; add assert!(tx_context::epoch(ctx) >= proposal.voting_end, ERROR_VOTING_NOT_ENDED) before finalizing.

Label: SecurityError/NoDoubleVotePrevention
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoDoubleVotePrevention: cast_vote never records that a voter has voted; the same wallet can call cast_vote multiple times and add their voting power repeatedly; store voted addresses in a Table and assert !table::contains(&proposal.voters, voter) before counting the vote.

Label: SecurityError/RelativeMajorityWithoutQuorum
Output/Fix: SecurityError/RelativeMajorityWithoutQuorum: approval requires only more votes_for than votes_against with no quorum requirement; a proposal can pass with 1 vote for and 0 against; add a minimum participation check: (votes_for + votes_against) * 10000 / total_supply >= QUORUM_BPS.

Label: SecurityError/TimelockQueueBypassable
Output/Fix: SecurityError/TimelockQueueBypassable: a proposal with ready_time <= current epoch is executed immediately without being queued; this allows bypassing the timelock by setting ready_time in the past; always queue every proposal and execute only from the queue after the delay has elapsed.

Label: SecurityError/VoteWeightTransferableDuringVoting
Output/Fix: SecurityError/VoteWeightTransferableDuringVoting: tokens can be transferred freely while votes are active, allowing vote weight to be used multiple times by different wallets; lock transferred tokens until all proposals the sender voted in have concluded.

Label: SecurityError/GovernanceParamChangedBeforeExecution
Output/Fix: SecurityError/GovernanceParamChangedBeforeExecution: quorum is lowered and then immediately used to approve a proposal in the same call; a privileged actor can reduce quorum to 1 bps and auto-approve any proposal; governance parameter changes should require their own timelocked proposal and must not affect in-flight votes.

Label: SecurityError/UnilateralVetoRight
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnilateralVetoRight: any single address can unilaterally veto any proposal; a single token holder or contract can block all governance; require a multi-sig veto council or a minimum percentage of total supply to trigger a veto.

Label: SecurityError/NoProposalExecutionExpiry
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoProposalExecutionExpiry: passed proposals have no expiry; a proposal passed months ago with stale parameters can be executed at any time; add an execution window: assert tx_context::epoch(ctx) <= proposal.execution_deadline.

Label: SecurityError/GaslessVoteReplayable
Output/Fix: SecurityError/GaslessVoteReplayable: the signed vote message contains no nonce or chain ID; the same signature can be replayed on a different proposal or chain; include proposal_id, chain_id, dao_address, and a nonce in the signed message and track used nonces.

Label: SecurityError/CircularVoteDelegation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/CircularVoteDelegation: a delegation chain A -> B -> A creates an infinite loop when resolving delegated voting power; assert delegatee != tx_context::sender(ctx) and traverse the delegation chain to ensure no cycle exists before recording the delegation.

Label: SecurityError/UnboundedItemSize
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnboundedItemSize: item size is unchecked; large items inflate storage costs for the object owner and can be used to bloat shared state; add assert!(vector::length(&item) <= MAX_ITEM_BYTES, ERROR_ITEM_TOO_LARGE).

Label: SecurityError/UnboundedEventEmission
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnboundedEventEmission: events are emitted for every subscriber without a cap; a large subscriber list makes every notify call prohibitively expensive; add assert!(table::length(&registry.subscribers) <= MAX_SUBSCRIBERS) at registration time.

Label: SecurityError/QuadraticComplexityDos
Output/Fix: SecurityError/QuadraticComplexityDos: nested loops produce O(n²) gas cost; with list_a and list_b each of length 1000 the function performs 1M iterations; add assert!(vector::length(list_a) <= MAX_LIST && vector::length(list_b) <= MAX_LIST).

Label: SecurityError/UnboundedSnapshotCopy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnboundedSnapshotCopy: copying the entire holders vector is O(n) in gas; with thousands of holders this exceeds the gas limit; use pagination with start_index and page_size parameters, or maintain a separate bounded snapshot structure.

Label: SecurityError/UnboundedStringStorage
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnboundedStringStorage: description string length is not validated; storing a megabyte-long description inflates storage costs for the object owner and wastes network resources; assert string::length(&description) <= MAX_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH.

Label: SecurityError/UnboundedVoterList
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnboundedVoterList: the voter list grows without a cap; iterating over all voters at proposal finalization will eventually exceed gas limits; use a Table for O(1) lookup and avoid iterating the full voter set.

Label: SecurityError/UnboundedRecursiveTreeTraversal
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnboundedRecursiveTreeTraversal: sum_tree is recursive with no depth limit; a deeply nested tree exhausts the call stack and exceeds gas; add a depth parameter and assert depth <= MAX_DEPTH, or redesign using an iterative approach with an explicit stack.

Label: SecurityError/AirdropBatchSizeUnbounded
Output/Fix: SecurityError/AirdropBatchSizeUnbounded: recipients vector has no size limit; a batch of thousands of addresses will exceed the transaction gas budget; add assert!(vector::length(&recipients) <= MAX_AIRDROP_BATCH, ERROR_BATCH_TOO_LARGE).

Label: SecurityError/UnboundedMergeOperation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnboundedMergeOperation: merge operates on unbounded input vectors; gas cost is O(n + m); add assert!(vector::length(&a) + vector::length(&b) <= MAX_MERGE_SIZE, ERROR_TOO_LARGE) before merging.

Label: SecurityError/UnboundedCleanupLoop
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnboundedCleanupLoop: cleanup iterates the entire entries vector in one transaction; with many entries this exceeds gas; redesign as a paginated cleanup: accept a max_cleanups: u64 parameter and stop after processing that many entries.

Label: SecurityError/UnvalidatedDestinationAddress
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnvalidatedDestinationAddress: dest_address format is not validated against the destination chain's address format; an EVM address is 20 bytes while a Sui address is 32 bytes; incorrect format means tokens are locked on the source chain but unreachable on the destination; validate address length for each dest_chain.

Label: SecurityError/NoBridgeFee
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoBridgeFee: no fee is deducted for bridge transfers; relayers have no economic incentive to process messages; add a bridge fee deducted from amount and paid to the relayer pool: assert amount > min_transfer + bridge_fee.

Label: SecurityError/WithdrawalOnPausedBridge
Output/Fix: SecurityError/WithdrawalOnPausedBridge: the bridge pause mechanism does not block withdrawals; a bridge is usually paused during a security incident and withdrawals should also be halted; add assert!(!bridge.paused, ERROR_BRIDGE_PAUSED) to all state-changing functions.

Label: SecurityError/InstantBridgeUpgrade
Output/Fix: SecurityError/InstantBridgeUpgrade: bridge implementation can be changed instantly with no timelock; a compromised admin key can redirect all bridge funds immediately; require a multi-sig approval and a minimum 48-hour timelock before bridge implementation changes take effect.

Label: SecurityError/UnwhitelistedRelayerAccepted
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnwhitelistedRelayerAccepted: any address can act as a relayer; a malicious relayer can submit crafted messages; require the relayer to be in bridge.approved_relayers and that signatures from a threshold of validators accompany the message.

Label: SecurityError/OutOfOrderNonceAccepted
Output/Fix: SecurityError/OutOfOrderNonceAccepted: nonces are checked for uniqueness but not for sequence order; gaps in nonce sequence can indicate missing messages that were dropped or censored; enforce strict sequential ordering: assert nonce == bridge.next_expected_nonce and increment after processing.

Label: SecurityError/UnwhitelistedTokenBridged
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnwhitelistedTokenBridged: any coin type T can be bridged without validation; a malicious token with a custom transfer hook or a worthless token could be bridged, misleading the destination chain; maintain a whitelist of approved token types and assert T is in the whitelist.

Label: SecurityError/InsufficientBridgeFinality
Output/Fix: SecurityError/InsufficientBridgeFinality: bridge deposit is finalised after a single confirmation without waiting for source chain finality; on chains with reorgs (e.g., Ethereum pre-finality) the source transaction may be reversed; require a minimum confirmation count before minting bridged tokens.

Label: SecurityError/BridgeEmergencyWithdrawSingleAdmin
Output/Fix: SecurityError/BridgeEmergencyWithdrawSingleAdmin: all bridge reserves can be withdrawn by a single admin address in an emergency; a compromised admin key triggers full fund loss; require multi-sig approval (e.g., 3-of-5 guardians) for emergency withdrawals and emit a detailed audit event.

Label: SecurityError/BridgeDailyLimitNotEnforced
Output/Fix: SecurityError/BridgeDailyLimitNotEnforced: daily_volume is tracked but never checked against a limit; an attacker can drain the bridge in a single large transaction; add assert!(bridge.daily_volume + amount <= bridge.daily_limit, ERROR_DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED) before locking tokens.

Label: SecurityError/NoLtvRatioEnforced
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoLtvRatioEnforced: borrow_max issues debt equal to 100% of collateral value; any price drop immediately makes the position insolvent; enforce a maximum LTV ratio: borrow_amount <= collateral_value * MAX_LTV_BPS / 10000.

Label: SecurityError/AmmInvariantNotVerified
Output/Fix: SecurityError/AmmInvariantNotVerified: the constant product invariant k = x * y is never verified after the swap; rounding errors accumulate over time draining the pool; add assert!((pool.reserve_x * pool.reserve_y) >= k_before, ERROR_INVARIANT_BROKEN) after updating reserves.

Label: SecurityError/LpInflationAttackOnInit
Output/Fix: SecurityError/LpInflationAttackOnInit: initial LP tokens are minted 1:1 with amount_x; an attacker can initialise with tiny amounts and then donate tokens directly to inflate the share price, diluting subsequent LPs; mint initial LP as sqrt(amount_x * amount_y) and subtract a MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY lock.

Label: SecurityError/ExchangeRateManipulableByDonation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ExchangeRateManipulableByDonation: exchange rate uses the live total_assets which includes direct donations; an attacker can inflate the rate by donating tokens, making subsequent depositors receive fewer shares; track assets via deposits only, ignoring unrequested transfers.

Label: SecurityError/LiquidationWithoutHealthCheck
Output/Fix: SecurityError/LiquidationWithoutHealthCheck: liquidation does not verify the position is actually under-collateralised before seizing collateral; a healthy position can be liquidated; add assert!(position_health(market, borrower) < MIN_HEALTH_FACTOR, ERROR_POSITION_HEALTHY) before seizing.

Label: SecurityError/RedemptionIgnoresCollateralRatio
Output/Fix: SecurityError/RedemptionIgnoresCollateralRatio: stablecoin is redeemed at face value even when the protocol is under-collateralised; this allows early redeemers to drain all collateral leaving later redeemers with nothing; check collateral ratio and apply a pro-rata redemption if below peg.

Label: SecurityError/PerpEntryPriceNotValidated
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PerpEntryPriceNotValidated: there is no max_entry_price parameter; the position is opened at mark_price which can be manipulated between submission and execution; add a max_entry_price: u64 parameter and assert entry_price <= max_entry_price.

Label: SecurityError/OptionExerciseWithoutITMCheck
Output/Fix: SecurityError/OptionExerciseWithoutITMCheck: call option can be exercised even when the underlying price is below the strike price (out-of-the-money); the protocol would pay out while receiving below-market collateral; add assert!(current_price >= option.strike_price, ERROR_OPTION_OTM).

Label: SecurityError/FundingCollectionExceedsCollateral
Output/Fix: SecurityError/FundingCollectionExceedsCollateral: funding deduction does not check that remaining collateral stays non-negative; if funding > collateral the subtraction underflows; add assert!(position.collateral >= funding, ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_COLLATERAL) before deducting.

Label: SecurityError/RemoveLiquidityNoMinimumOutput
Output/Fix: SecurityError/RemoveLiquidityNoMinimumOutput: remove_liquidity has no minimum output parameters; a sandwiching attack can manipulate pool reserves before the transaction to reduce the output; add min_out_x: u64 and min_out_y: u64 parameters and assert out_x >= min_out_x && out_y >= min_out_y.

Label: SecurityError/StableSwapMissingAmplification
Output/Fix: SecurityError/StableSwapMissingAmplification: stable swap uses the constant product formula instead of the StableSwap invariant with amplification; the pool will have excessive slippage for stablecoin pairs; implement the StableSwap invariant: x^n + y^n + An(x+y) = D.

Label: SecurityError/BorrowExceedsSupplyCap
Output/Fix: SecurityError/BorrowExceedsSupplyCap: total borrows are tracked but never checked against the borrow cap; unlimited borrowing can drain all supplied liquidity; add assert!(market.total_borrowed + amount <= market.borrow_cap, ERROR_BORROW_CAP_EXCEEDED).

Label: SecurityError/UtilizationRateDivisionByZero
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UtilizationRateDivisionByZero: utilization_rate divides by total_supplied which can be zero when no liquidity is provided; add assert!(market.total_supplied > 0, ERROR_EMPTY_MARKET) or return 0 when total_supplied == 0.

Label: SecurityError/PartialRepaymentCollateralRelease
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PartialRepaymentCollateralRelease: collateral is released without verifying the repayment covers the full outstanding debt; a partial repayment allows draining collateral while leaving residual debt; add assert!(coin::value(&repayment) >= cdp.debt, ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_REPAYMENT).

Label: SecurityError/PostTradePriceCalculationError
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PostTradePriceCalculationError: post-trade price formula subtracts amount_in from reserve_y instead of reserve_x; the formula is incorrect and produces a wrong price impact estimate; post-trade price should be computed as (pool.reserve_y - amount_out) / (pool.reserve_x + amount_in).

Label: SecurityError/SharesToAssetsZeroTotalShares
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SharesToAssetsZeroTotalShares: division by vault.total_shares aborts when the vault has no shares outstanding (e.g., after all withdrawals); add assert!(vault.total_shares > 0, ERROR_EMPTY_VAULT) or return 0 when total_shares == 0.

Label: SecurityError/FeeNotCollectedToProtocol
Output/Fix: SecurityError/FeeNotCollectedToProtocol: fee is deducted from the receiver's credited amount but is not added to any protocol fee accumulator; the tokens are effectively burned; credit the fee to a designated fee recipient or protocol treasury balance.

Label: SecurityError/PnlCalculationUnderflow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PnlCalculationUnderflow: pos.current_value - pos.entry_value underflows u64 when the position is in loss (current_value < entry_value); handle negative PnL separately: if current_value < entry_value deduct the loss from collateral instead of subtracting unsigned integers.

Label: SecurityError/UnvalidatedNftCollectionOnStake
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnvalidatedNftCollectionOnStake: any NFT from any collection can be staked regardless of its rarity, collection, or value; an attacker can stake worthless NFTs and earn rewards; verify the NFT's collection address matches pool.accepted_collection before accepting.

Label: SecurityError/ItemUsedWithoutOwnershipCheck
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ItemUsedWithoutOwnershipCheck: any player can use any item by supplying the item_id without proving ownership; add assert!(item.owner == tx_context::sender(ctx), ERROR_NOT_OWNER) before applying the item effect.

Label: SecurityError/DeterministicRarityAssignment
Output/Fix: SecurityError/DeterministicRarityAssignment: rarity is assigned as id % 5 which is fully predictable before mint; buyers can calculate their exact rarity and cherry-pick mints; use a VRF-seeded reveal or commit-reveal with an unpredictable beacon to assign rarities fairly.

Label: SecurityError/UnauthorizedExperienceGrant
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnauthorizedExperienceGrant: any caller can grant arbitrary XP to any character; add require a GameServerCap parameter or assert the caller is the authorised game server address before granting experience.

Label: SecurityError/NftFusionWithoutOwnershipVerification
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NftFusionWithoutOwnershipVerification: NFTs passed by value imply Move ownership, but in shared object scenarios the caller may not be the intended owner; verify that both NFT owner fields match tx_context::sender(ctx) before destroying them.

Label: SecurityError/MarketplaceFeeNotDeducted
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MarketplaceFeeNotDeducted: the full payment is forwarded to the seller with no marketplace fee deducted; split the payment: deduct listing.price * MARKETPLACE_FEE_BPS / 10000 and send it to the fee recipient before forwarding the remainder to the seller.

Label: SecurityError/AchievementClaimedWithoutValidation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/AchievementClaimedWithoutValidation: achievement is granted and reward minted without verifying the player has actually met the achievement conditions; require a GameServerCap or a merkle proof signed by the game backend to prove the achievement was legitimately earned.

Label: SecurityError/UpgradeMaterialsNotConsumed
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UpgradeMaterialsNotConsumed: upgrade_nft accepts materials vector but never burns or verifies them; players can call upgrade without providing valid materials; iterate materials, verify types and quantities, then destroy each material item before applying the upgrade.

Label: SecurityError/PvpChallengerOwnershipNotVerified
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PvpChallengerOwnershipNotVerified: there is no check that the sender owns the challenger character; any player can use any character in battle; add assert!(arena.characters[challenger_id].owner == tx_context::sender(ctx), ERROR_NOT_OWNER) before resolving the battle.

Label: SecurityError/NftCollateralWithoutFloorPrice
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NftCollateralWithoutFloorPrice: any NFT is accepted as collateral for any loan amount; a worthless NFT can collateralise an arbitrary loan; integrate a verified collection floor price oracle and assert loan_amount <= floor_price * MAX_NFT_LTV_BPS / 10000.

Label: SecurityError/HardcodedAdminAddress
Output/Fix: SecurityError/HardcodedAdminAddress: admin address is hardcoded as a constant; if the admin key is compromised there is no way to update it; pass the admin address as a parameter to the initializer and allow admin rotation via a two-step ownership transfer mechanism.

Label: SecurityError/SilentPausedReturn
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SilentPausedReturn: when the vault is paused the function returns silently with no error; callers cannot distinguish a paused vault from a successful zero-amount transfer; use assert!(!vault.paused, ERROR_VAULT_PAUSED) to abort with a descriptive error code.

Label: SecurityError/NumericErrorCodes
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NumericErrorCodes: error codes 1, 2, 3 are numeric constants with no semantic meaning; debugging failures requires source code lookup; define named constants: const ERROR_ZERO_VALUE: u64 = 1; const ERROR_EXCEEDS_MAX: u64 = 2; const ERROR_INACTIVE: u64 = 3.

Label: SecurityError/ObsoleteVersionFunctionCallable
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ObsoleteVersionFunctionCallable: process_v1 bypasses the zero-value check introduced in v2 and remains publicly callable after the upgrade; add a version check at the start of process_v1: assert!(obj.version < 2, ERROR_DEPRECATED) or remove the function in the upgrade.

Label: SecurityError/MultiPhaseInitStepNotVerified
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MultiPhaseInitStepNotVerified: phase_two does not verify that partial.step == 1; if a Partial object is created out-of-band with an incorrect step value, phase_two will still complete initialisation in an invalid state; add assert!(partial.step == 1, ERROR_INVALID_PHASE) before completing.

Label: SecurityError/SharedObjectRaceCondition
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SharedObjectRaceCondition: reading old_value and writing back old_value + 1 on a shared object is safe within a single transaction due to Sui's object locking, but the logic depends on the assumption of exclusive access; document that concurrent transactions are serialised by Sui consensus and that counter increments are atomic per-transaction.

Label: SecurityError/MutableUpgradeCapNotRestricted
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MutableUpgradeCapNotRestricted: holding an UpgradeCap with UpgradePolicy::COMPATIBLE allows arbitrary code changes to the package; consider calling package::restrict to UpgradePolicy::ADDITIVE_ONLY or package::make_immutable after deployment to limit upgrade scope.

Label: SecurityError/FriendFunctionWithoutFriendDeclaration
Output/Fix: SecurityError/FriendFunctionWithoutFriendDeclaration: public(friend) visibility requires a friend declaration in the module header; without it the function is effectively public; add `friend package::trusted_module;` to restrict callers, or redesign using capability objects if the friend pattern is not appropriate.

Label: SecurityError/SensitiveDataInEvent
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SensitiveDataInEvent: secret_price is emitted in a public event; all Sui events are publicly observable on-chain; if the price is intended to be private (e.g., for a sealed-bid mechanism) do not emit it in an event before the reveal phase.

Label: SecurityError/SingleStepAdminTransfer
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SingleStepAdminTransfer: AdminCap is transferred immediately to new_admin with no acceptance step; if new_admin is entered incorrectly the cap is permanently lost; implement a two-step transfer: set a pending_admin field and require new_admin to call accept_admin() to complete the transfer.

Label: SecurityError/UnboundedObjectCreation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnboundedObjectCreation: count objects are created without a limit; each object requires storage deposit from the transaction sender; creating thousands of objects in one transaction exhausts the gas budget and the sender's SUI balance; add assert!(count <= MAX_OBJECTS_PER_TX, ERROR_TOO_MANY_OBJECTS).

Label: SecurityError/TruncatingDowncast
Output/Fix: SecurityError/TruncatingDowncast: casting u64 to u8 silently truncates values above 255; for example 256 as u8 == 0; add assert!(value <= 255, ERROR_OVERFLOW) before the cast to prevent silent data loss.

Label: SecurityError/DivisionModuloByZero
Output/Fix: SecurityError/DivisionModuloByZero: both a / b and a % b abort when b == 0; add assert!(b > 0, ERROR_DIVISION_BY_ZERO) before the operations to provide a meaningful error code instead of an opaque arithmetic abort.

Label: SecurityError/InitWithoutPublisherCapture
Output/Fix: SecurityError/InitWithoutPublisherCapture: the init function does not capture the one-time witness or Publisher object; without Publisher the module cannot participate in Sui's display or transfer policy framework; accept the one-time witness as the first parameter to init: fun init(_witness: MY_MODULE, ctx: &mut TxContext).

Label: SecurityError/NonEmptyTableDestroyAbort
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NonEmptyTableDestroyAbort: table::destroy_empty aborts if the table still contains entries; deleting a registry with active entries permanently reverts the transaction; either iterate and remove all entries first, or use table::drop if T has the drop ability.

Label: SecurityError/NoExecutorRestrictionOnTimelock
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoExecutorRestrictionOnTimelock: any caller can execute a timelocked action once the delay has elapsed; while not immediately dangerous, a malicious executor can time execution adversarially; restrict execution to the original proposer or a whitelisted keeper address.

Label: SecurityError/SingleAdminChangesMultisigThreshold
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SingleAdminChangesMultisigThreshold: the multi-sig threshold can be changed by a single admin without requiring multi-sig approval; a compromised admin can lower the threshold to 1 and act unilaterally; require a multi-sig approval to change the threshold itself.

Label: SecurityError/InstantOracleReplacement
Output/Fix: SecurityError/InstantOracleReplacement: oracle addresses can be swapped instantaneously; an attacker who compromises the admin key can point the oracle to a malicious price feed and immediately drain lending protocols; require a 48-hour timelock for oracle replacements.

Label: SecurityError/RewardTokenSwappable
Output/Fix: SecurityError/RewardTokenSwappable: the reward token can be changed at any time; users who staked expecting token A as rewards could find the reward token changed to a worthless token; lock the reward token after the first deposit or require governance approval and a timelock to change it.

Label: SecurityError/ProxyUpgradeNoAccessControl
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ProxyUpgradeNoAccessControl: proxy implementation can be changed without any capability check; any caller can redirect all proxy calls to a malicious address; require a ProxyAdminCap parameter and a timelock delay before the new implementation takes effect.

Label: SecurityError/MarketplaceListingReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MarketplaceListingReentrancy: listing is removed after nft and payment transfers; remove the listing from the table before executing transfers so re-entrant calls find the listing already gone and abort.

Label: SecurityError/RoyaltyCompoundingOnReducedBalance
Output/Fix: SecurityError/RoyaltyCompoundingOnReducedBalance: each royalty is calculated as bps of the current (already-reduced) payment balance; later royalty recipients receive less than their intended share; calculate all royalty amounts from the original payment value before any splits.

Label: SecurityError/BatchPayoutNoTotalCheck
Output/Fix: SecurityError/BatchPayoutNoTotalCheck: total payout amount is never validated against treasury balance before starting; partial execution on a failed transfer midway through leaves the treasury in a partially-paid state; sum all payout amounts first and assert the total <= treasury balance before transferring.

Label: SecurityError/ExternalCallBeforeStateFinalization
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ExternalCallBeforeStateFinalization: the external callback is invoked before finalize_swap completes the pool state update; a malicious callback can re-enter the pool while reserves are in an intermediate state; call finalize_swap before notify_callback.

Label: SecurityError/RewardUpdateClaimReentrancy
Output/Fix: SecurityError/RewardUpdateClaimReentrancy: user_rewards is zeroed after transfer_rewards; zero the reward before calling transfer_rewards to prevent a re-entrant claim that reads the non-zero reward and claims it a second time.

Label: SecurityError/ZeroAddressFeeRecipient
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ZeroAddressFeeRecipient: recipient is not validated; setting fee_recipient to @0x0 permanently burns all accumulated fees; assert!(recipient != @0x0, ERROR_ZERO_ADDRESS) before updating.

Label: SecurityError/RevenueSplitDoesNotSumToHundred
Output/Fix: SecurityError/RevenueSplitDoesNotSumToHundred: individual bps values are stored without verifying their sum equals 10000; splits that sum to more than 10000 overpay recipients; splits that sum to less permanently lose revenue; assert!(protocol_bps + treasury_bps + team_bps == 10000, ERROR_INVALID_SPLIT).

Label: SecurityError/ZeroLockDurationAllowed
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ZeroLockDurationAllowed: duration_days = 0 is accepted creating a lock that unlocks immediately; the user bypasses any lock-based reward boost; add a minimum: assert!(duration_days >= MIN_LOCK_DAYS, ERROR_LOCK_TOO_SHORT).

Label: SecurityError/InterestRateUncapped
Output/Fix: SecurityError/InterestRateUncapped: base_rate_bps has no upper bound; setting it to 10000 (100%) per epoch compounding would drain borrowers instantly; assert base_rate_bps <= MAX_BASE_RATE_BPS (e.g., 2000 for 20% annual).

Label: SecurityError/RequiredSigsExceedsValidatorCount
Output/Fix: SecurityError/RequiredSigsExceedsValidatorCount: required_sigs is not validated against the validator set size; if required_sigs > validators.length the bridge can never process any message; assert 0 < required_sigs <= vector::length(&validators).

Label: SecurityError/EmissionRateUncapped
Output/Fix: SecurityError/EmissionRateUncapped: tokens_per_epoch has no maximum; setting it to a large value inflates the token supply in a single epoch; assert tokens_per_epoch <= MAX_EMISSION_PER_EPOCH and emit an EmissionRateChanged event.

Label: SecurityError/UnboundedAttributeCount
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnboundedAttributeCount: attributes can be added without limit; an NFT with thousands of attributes wastes storage and makes the object expensive to operate; assert table::length(&nft.attributes) < MAX_ATTRIBUTES before adding a new one.

Label: SecurityError/DuplicateMemberNotPrevented
Output/Fix: SecurityError/DuplicateMemberNotPrevented: add_member does not check whether new_member already exists in the member list; duplicate members can vote twice if quorum is counted by member count; use a Table instead of a vector and assert !table::contains(&dao.members, new_member) before adding.

Label: SecurityError/NoBorrowHealthCheckAfterDebt
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoBorrowHealthCheckAfterDebt: debt is incremented without re-computing the position health factor; the new borrow may push the position below the minimum collateral ratio; assert health_factor(market, oracle, borrower) >= MIN_HEALTH after incrementing debt.

Label: SecurityError/MintingSynthWithoutOracleValidation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MintingSynthWithoutOracleValidation: oracle.price is used directly without checking freshness or sanity bounds; a stale or manipulated price mints incorrect synth amounts; verify oracle.last_update is recent and price is within acceptable bounds before minting.

Label: SecurityError/ReserveRatioBelowMinimum
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ReserveRatioBelowMinimum: withdrawing reserves does not check that the remaining reserves cover the minimum ratio relative to outstanding debt; compute remaining_reserves / total_liabilities after the withdrawal and assert the ratio >= MIN_RESERVE_RATIO.

Label: SecurityError/FeeNotRetainedInPool
Output/Fix: SecurityError/FeeNotRetainedInPool: reserve_x is increased by the gross amount_in but the swap output is computed on amount_after_fee; the fee portion inflates reserve_x without a corresponding allocation; decide whether fees stay in reserves (add gross to reserve_x) or accumulate separately (add only net to reserve_x).

Label: SecurityError/LpSharesMintedAtWrongRate
Output/Fix: SecurityError/LpSharesMintedAtWrongRate: LP shares are minted 1:1 with the deposited amount ignoring interest already accrued; early suppliers are diluted by later depositors; compute shares as amount * total_shares / total_assets to mint proportionally to the current exchange rate.

Label: SecurityError/ZeroCollateralAdditionAllowed
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ZeroCollateralAdditionAllowed: adding 0-value collateral wastes gas and pollutes the transaction history with no economic effect; assert coin::value(&extra) > 0 before processing the collateral addition.

Label: SecurityError/NoOverCollateralisationRequirement
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoOverCollateralisationRequirement: stablecoin is minted 1:1 with the USD value of collateral with no safety buffer; any price drop immediately makes the protocol insolvent; require over-collateralisation: mint_amount = collateral_usd * 10000 / MIN_COLLATERAL_RATIO_BPS.

Label: SecurityError/PendingRewardsNotSnapshotted
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PendingRewardsNotSnapshotted: pending rewards are not checkpointed before adding new LP; the new stake immediately increases the user's share of future rewards without accounting for rewards accrued before the deposit; call update_user_reward_debt(farm, sender) before modifying user_lp.

Label: SecurityError/FeeConstantMiscalculated
Output/Fix: SecurityError/FeeConstantMiscalculated: SWAP_FEE = 9970 represents the post-fee multiplier (99.7%), but the constant name suggests it is the fee itself; this is misleading and error-prone; rename to POST_FEE_MULTIPLIER or represent the fee as FEE_BPS = 30 and compute amount * (10000 - FEE_BPS) / 10000.

Label: SecurityError/InitializableMultipleTimes
Output/Fix: SecurityError/InitializableMultipleTimes: initialize can be called multiple times creating multiple GlobalState shared objects; later calls replace the canonical state reference in the dApp frontend; use a one-time witness pattern or check the package has no existing GlobalState before creating one.

Label: SecurityError/SolvencyCheckSkippedWhenNoLiabilities
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SolvencyCheckSkippedWhenNoLiabilities: solvency is only checked when total_liabilities > 0; if total_assets is also 0 (empty protocol) the check passes trivially; always verify total_assets >= total_liabilities regardless of liabilities being zero.

Label: SecurityError/MigrationNewFieldUninitialised
Output/Fix: SecurityError/MigrationNewFieldUninitialised: new_field is set to 0 as a default without documenting the migration assumption; if 0 is not a valid initialisation for new_field it will corrupt protocol invariants; document the chosen default explicitly and assert it is within valid bounds after migration.

Label: SecurityError/PrivateKeyExposedOnChain
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PrivateKeyExposedOnChain: storing and returning a private_key on-chain exposes it to all network participants; blockchain storage is public; private keys must never be stored on-chain; use a threshold signature scheme or off-chain key management instead.

Label: SecurityError/StalenessThresholdTooShort
Output/Fix: SecurityError/StalenessThresholdTooShort: a staleness threshold of 1 epoch means the price is considered stale after a single missed update; network congestion can cause legitimate oracles to miss updates; use a threshold of at least MAX_ORACLE_UPDATE_DELAY epochs and make it configurable by governance.

Label: SecurityError/CapabilityWithCopyAbility
Output/Fix: SecurityError/CapabilityWithCopyAbility: Config has the copy ability; any holder can duplicate the config and modify their copy independently; configuration and capability structs should not have copy; remove the copy ability and mutate fields directly via the mutable reference.

Label: SecurityError/EpochExactMatchClaimWindow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/EpochExactMatchClaimWindow: using == for epoch comparison creates a one-epoch claim window; if the user misses that exact epoch the reward is permanently unclaimable; use >= to allow claims from target_epoch onwards, or define an explicit end epoch: target_epoch <= epoch < target_epoch + WINDOW.

Label: SecurityError/PoolHealthCheckIncomplete
Output/Fix: SecurityError/PoolHealthCheckIncomplete: pool health is checked by token reserves alone; a pool with non-zero reserves but zero LP shares outstanding indicates corrupted state (all LPs have withdrawn but reserves remain); also assert pool.total_lp > 0 for a complete health check.

Label: SecurityError/ReceiverBlacklistNotChecked
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ReceiverBlacklistNotChecked: blacklist check only applies to the sender; tokens can still be transferred to a blacklisted address; add assert!(!table::contains(&registry.blacklist, to), ERROR_RECIPIENT_BLACKLISTED) before executing the transfer.

Label: SecurityError/BridgeConfirmationTooLow
Output/Fix: SecurityError/BridgeConfirmationTooLow: the comment indicates 1-confirmation processing; on proof-of-work chains with reorgs, a 1-confirmation transaction can be reversed; require at least SAFE_CONFIRMATION_COUNT confirmations stored as part of the source_tx proof before minting.

Label: SecurityError/DuplicateSignaturesCounted
Output/Fix: SecurityError/DuplicateSignaturesCounted: the same validator signature can be submitted twice in the sigs vector and counted as two approvals; track which validator addresses have already been counted and skip duplicates: use a Table<address, bool> of seen signers within the loop.

Label: SecurityError/BridgeDecimalMismatch
Output/Fix: SecurityError/BridgeDecimalMismatch: wrapped and native tokens are exchanged 1:1 without adjusting for decimal differences; if wrapped token has 18 decimals and native has 6 decimals, burning 1e18 wrapped would release 1e18 native tokens instead of 1e6; apply the decimal adjustment factor during unwrapping.

Label: SecurityError/BridgeLockWithoutOwnerRecord
Output/Fix: SecurityError/BridgeLockWithoutOwnerRecord: tokens are locked in the bridge without recording the depositor address; if the bridge-out fails on the destination chain there is no record of who should receive a refund; store a mapping of depositor -> amount and nonce for refund processing.

Label: SecurityError/BridgeMintingCapSetToZero
Output/Fix: SecurityError/BridgeMintingCapSetToZero: daily_cap can be set to 0 which permanently prevents any token from being bridged in, effectively bricking the inbound bridge; assert daily_cap >= MIN_BRIDGE_CAP before updating, and require governance approval for any reduction.

Label: SecurityError/AdminCanCancelAnyProposal
Output/Fix: SecurityError/AdminCanCancelAnyProposal: a single admin can cancel any queued proposal undermining the purpose of decentralised governance; restrict cancellation to proposals still in the voting phase and require multi-sig or guardian approval for post-vote cancellation.

Label: SecurityError/VotingEscrowNoUnlock
Output/Fix: SecurityError/VotingEscrowNoUnlock: tokens are locked in the voting escrow with no unlock function; voters' tokens are permanently trapped; implement an unlock mechanism with a minimum lock period and ensure tokens are released after voting power expires.

Label: SecurityError/VoterIncentiveWithoutVoteVerification
Output/Fix: SecurityError/VoterIncentiveWithoutVoteVerification: vote incentive is distributed without verifying the voter actually participated in the specified proposal; assert table::contains(&dao.votes[proposal_id], voter) before distributing the incentive.

Label: SecurityError/VotingPowerFromCurrentBalance
Output/Fix: SecurityError/VotingPowerFromCurrentBalance: voting power is read from the current live balance instead of a snapshot taken at proposal creation; a voter can acquire tokens, vote, then sell and vote again on a different proposal with the same tokens; snapshot balances at proposal creation time.

Label: SecurityError/ProposalDependencyNotVerified
Output/Fix: SecurityError/ProposalDependencyNotVerified: proposals with dependencies can be executed even if prerequisite proposals failed or were not yet executed; check each proposal in proposal.prerequisites and assert it is in EXECUTED state before proceeding.

Label: SecurityError/SingleGuardianCanPauseProtocol
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SingleGuardianCanPauseProtocol: a single compromised guardian key can pause the entire protocol; while fast pausing is desirable in emergencies, require at least 2 of N guardians to agree or implement a pause-only guardian with an automatic unpause timeout.

Label: SecurityError/NoTreasuryProposalAmountCap
Output/Fix: SecurityError/NoTreasuryProposalAmountCap: a treasury proposal can request any amount including the entire treasury balance; require amount <= MAX_SINGLE_PROPOSAL_AMOUNT and a higher quorum threshold for large amounts (e.g., >10% of treasury requires 2/3 quorum).

Label: SecurityError/BatchVoteWithoutCooldown
Output/Fix: SecurityError/BatchVoteWithoutCooldown: batch voting on multiple proposals in one transaction allows a whale to quickly dominate all active proposals; add a per-proposal vote cooldown per address, or limit batch votes to assert!(vector::length(&proposal_ids) <= MAX_BATCH_VOTES).

Label: SecurityError/BulkParameterUpdateNoValidation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/BulkParameterUpdateNoValidation: all protocol parameters are replaced in one operation with no per-field validation; a single malformed params struct corrupts all settings simultaneously; validate each field individually before updating and emit a ParametersUpdated event for auditability.

Label: SecurityError/UnrestrictedFeeToggle
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnrestrictedFeeToggle: any caller can disable fee collection by setting fees_enabled = false, allowing free trades that drain LP rewards; require a FeeAdminCap parameter and emit a FeeToggled event before changing.

Label: SecurityError/SupplyNotDecrementedOnBurn
Output/Fix: SecurityError/SupplyNotDecrementedOnBurn: tokens are burned but treasury.total_supply is never decremented; the supply counter overstates the actual circulating supply breaking any supply-based calculations; add treasury.total_supply -= amount after burning.

Label: SecurityError/RepaymentExceedsDebt
Output/Fix: SecurityError/RepaymentExceedsDebt: loan.debt is decremented by the payment amount without checking the payment does not exceed outstanding debt; if payment >= loan.debt the subtraction underflows u64; assert!(amount <= loan.debt, ERROR_OVERPAYMENT) before decrementing.

Label: SecurityError/GaugeWeightExceedsTotalAllocation
Output/Fix: SecurityError/GaugeWeightExceedsTotalAllocation: gauge weight is set per-gauge without checking the sum of all weights stays <= 10000 bps; a voter can allocate 10000 bps to multiple gauges simultaneously inflating emissions; after updating, assert total of all voter.gauge_weights <= 10000.

Label: SecurityError/UnnecessaryRebalanceTrigger
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnnecessaryRebalanceTrigger: rebalance can be triggered even when portfolio weights are already at target; unnecessary rebalances incur swap fees and slippage that erode vault returns; assert that at least one weight deviates from its target by more than REBALANCE_THRESHOLD_BPS before proceeding.

Label: SecurityError/UnauthorizedHookRegistration
Output/Fix: SecurityError/UnauthorizedHookRegistration: any address can register a callback hook for any event type; a malicious hook called during a swap or liquidation can re-enter the protocol; require a HookRegistrarCap and validate the hook contract implements the expected interface before registration.

Label: SecurityError/InstantStrategySwap
Output/Fix: SecurityError/InstantStrategySwap: the yield strategy is replaced immediately; funds currently deployed in the old strategy are not migrated, potentially locking assets; implement a two-phase strategy migration: queue the new strategy, allow the old strategy to wind down, then activate the new one after all funds are safely returned.
